turningPoints.615–632: The Quran tells readers to consult the Torah and Gospel then in their hands
turningPoints.~633: So many reciters died in battle that the Quran had to be collected in writing
turningPoints.~650: Uthman fixed one text and ordered the rival copies burned; the alternatives are gone
turningPoints.1064: The claim that the Bible's text was corrupted first appears four centuries into Islam
turningPoints.1947: Bibles older than Islam came out of the ground, and they match the Bible today
